messages:
lee: quick heads-up—new hires hitting onboarding failure in samplekit json-mode. JS SDK validator rejects tool returns that are top-level arrays.
tara: can you paste a minimal repro from the tool?
lee: sure:
```json
[ { "name": "alpha", "score": 0.9 } ]
```
our schema is an object (name:string, score:number).
mike: ah, parity thing: python helper used to auto-unpack single-element arrays for fncall/json-mode; the JS helper validates strictly so it fails. also noticed retry middleware was stringifying results in one branch (old debug), which makes things worse (we get a string containing JSON).
tara: options: 1) relax schema (yuck), 2) fix retry stringify, 3) add normalization in JS helper to parse strings and unpack single-item arrays.
mike: prefer 2+3. i'll send a small helper patch: try JSON.parse if typeof === 'string', then if Array.isArray(v) && schema.type === 'object' && v.length === 1 -> v = v[0]. add telemetry when coercion happens.
ci-bot: created issue #3555: "devex: normalize js fncall outputs + remove stringify-on-retry" (mike)
lee: i'll patch sampleapp temporarily to accept array until the helper lands, and add unit tests for stringified-array case. thanks all.
